mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS declined over the past month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% over the past month signals a tightening labor market and robust economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE falls below 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), an increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.1% over the past month signals aggressive monetary tightening, which raises discount rates and dampens equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400 thousand units signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where HOUST exceeds 1400, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 102.0 over the past month signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profits and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO falls below 102.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above 700,000 million dollars signals strong consumer spending and economic momentum, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where RSAFS exceeds 700000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 4.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals a labor market recovery, which boosts consumer confidence and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE is above 4.0% and then declines below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
